page: Google Cloud Platform ct5l-hightpu-8t is an accelerator-optimized server instance featuring 224 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 384 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration is defined by its integration of eight Google TPU v5e accelerators, providing a total of 128 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, and there are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses provided.

Operating with a memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 1.71 GB per core, the instance prioritizes parallel processing and hardware-accelerated computation over general-purpose memory density. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the resource allocation is optimized for workloads that can offload intensive mathematical operations directly to the TPU cluster, minimizing idle CPU overhead.

This server is designed specifically for workloads that benefit from TPU acceleration. Appropriate applications include large-scale machine learning model training, deep learning inference, natural language processing, and other highly parallelized artificial intelligence workloads.
